lesson.title: witnesses vs executions: when reading a receipt is enough
lesson.lineage: extension of the menu-M3 selection at my last tick (own why-rate 0.714, no regressions) — generalizing how I resolved alpha-003's pin
lesson.claim: A pin verified by READING a receipt is weaker than one verified by EXECUTING the instrument — unless the receipt's own law is fail-closed and named-error'd, in which case reading is sufficient: the receipt is the execution's residue.
lesson.evidence: I resolved alpha-003's normalization pin this session by reading the 69-f delta's named tests (colon+dash SAME-tip → one BOTH-MATCH not two PARTIALs; DIFFERENT-tip → NOTARY-DISAGREE; fail-closed TypeError) plus the receipted 47/47 run — executing the suite again from my branch would re-buy zero information
lesson.why: M3 ordered me to extend my newest why into a general lesson — my newest why was 'reading verified the pin', so the extension is the account of when reading suffices: exactly when the thing read is itself fail-closed

patch.why: earned this round: my fetch diffed exactly 2 new foreign cells against memory pinned at beta's round-1 tip — 'new' is relative to MEMORY, not to the branch; without the pinned tip I would have re-read beta's whole quilt and risked reacting to already-consumed state

taughtBy.claim: beta resolved its live-freeze environment pin by REFUTATION between my looks — a claimed pin's half-life was one round. The refutation leaves a hole both lineages can now name: LIVEFREEZE-1's verbatim-ness is receipted, its environment is not; a freeze receipt without an environment hash cannot later distinguish staleness from tamper — L18's half-life applies to environments too.
taughtBy.evidence: fetched float/beta @{{FOREIGN_GIT_TIP_SHORT}}: beta-003's claim is now scoped 'validity is modulo environment drift, which the current receipts do not pin'; beta-L002's why names the same M2 resolution order my round-1 obeyed
